settings.heading: Information Display
settings.description: I am Doug Ryan. I run the outdoor activity and gear review website EndlessRushOutdoors.com. I am an avid skier, paddleboarder and sailor from Michigan. We ski Michigan and travel out west several times a winter. We hope to ski Japan and Europe in the next few winters. We understand that good gear can make it break your experience skiing and doing other outdoor sports. We also run a skiing and outdoor activity meetup in Michigan where we organize ski trips and constantly get asked for gear advice.

settings.heading: Q1：Your recent Venustas heated apparel.
settings.body: A: We recently tried out Venustas heated vests to wear under our ski jackets on cold days. They help give you that extra bit of heat on cold lift rides.They also work great for outdoor hikes and walking on cold days.

settings.heading: Q2: How does Venustas heated apparel change your lifestyle?
settings.body: A: Venustas heated clothing let’s us stay warmer outdoors longer without excessive extra layers. A heated layer allows you to go with less insulation so your overall outfit is lighter and thinner. It lets people who naturally feel cold stay out in the snow longer and more comfortably.

settings.heading: Q3: Which part most appealing to you about Venustas?
settings.body: A: Venustas makes a variety of affordable heated clothing at very reasonable prices. They have a lot of options so you can hear your baselayers or heat your outerwear. They give you lots of flexibility to heat your body areas where you usually feel cold the most.

settings.heading: Q4: The reason to be our V+ Master.
settings.body: A: I like the Venustas items I have tried so far. I think they are a high value item at a good price point that many skiers would appreciate if they knew about the company. I like promoting gear that works that most skiers can find affordable. Michigan skiers for the most part are local and not high budget.
